additionalInformation: Spell lifesteal from different sources stacks additively.
Multiple instances of spell lifesteal from the same source do not stack.
Multiple instances of AoE Radius Bonus from the same source do not stack.
description: The Bloodstone's bright ruby color is unmistakable on the battlefield, as the owner seems to have infinite vitality and spirit.
tips: Bloodpact makes spells with an area of effect restore large amounts of health and mana while fighting multiple targets.

notes: Spell Weakness Aura does not stack with Veil of Discord's Spell Weakness.
abilities.description: Increases Bloodstone's Spell Lifesteal to 60%. Lasts 5 seconds.

Enemy units take 10% increased damage from spells.

Radius: 1200

name: Bloodstone
